lf-diagram.description: A Mermaid diagram with optional comment targets on its named boxes.
lf-diagram.x-instructions: Write Mermaid source inside the pre, HTML-escaping & before < and >. Give each diagram an accTitle naming its subject and an accDescr explaining its relationships for a reader who cannot see it. Draw a chain of more than three steps top-down (flowchart TD), since a long horizontal chain scrolls past the page edge. Use Mermaid classes and page CSS with theme tokens where a node needs a distinct tone. Omit parts for one whole-diagram comment target. Set parts="all" to make every named flowchart node/subgraph, state/composite state, sequence participant, class/namespace, and ER entity a comment target. Edges, sequence messages, and chart marks have no stable source id.
lf-diagram.x-example:
flowchart TD
  accTitle: Checkout from cart to receipt
  accDescr: The cart reaches a payment decision; a paid order produces a receipt.
  Cart([Cart]) --> Pay{Paid?}
  Pay --> Receipt[(Receipt)]
